# r190: zero nominations; one fresh unresolved analytic question

The five-frequency cosine sign-correlation optimum remains unresolved. The published 2024 source gives {1,3,11,35,105} as a possible candidate and p5 <= 1/105. The latest obtained 2026 primary body proves the four-frequency case and the exponential rate, but only gives p5 >= 1/256. No all-frequency proof/refutation was obtained.
